## Workload

Kofi Asante completed 667 reads during 442 hours of grading activity. The recorded rate was 1.5 per hour. The workload was reviewed in relation to the available hours and the expected session pattern. The review found that the grading activity was maintained across the period assessed, with no change recommended to the current session pattern.

## Quality

A sample of 46 reads was checked as part of the quality review. Agreement between the original grading and the review was 67.4 per cent. The findings provide a basis for continued monitoring of grading consistency and support the existing review arrangements.

The review was completed by Priya Anand. The workload and quality results should continue to be considered together in future monitoring, with attention given to maintaining the current approach while addressing any variation identified through further checks.
